author: Ryan Allison
title: 'We're fired up': Nationally ranked YSU ready to kickoff season this Thursday - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Allison ,
1 days ago
YOUNGSTOWN, Ohio (WKBN) - The YSU football team will officially kick off the 2026 season Thursday night at Stambaugh Stadium, and this year the Penguins have loads of returning talent.
Watch the video above to hear from the players and head coach Doug Phillips ahead of the 2026 home opener.
YSU has five players on the roster with at least 20 starts already under their belt. That includes most of the offensive line, along with reigning Walter Payton Award winner Beau Brungard at quarterback.
This is a team with high expectations and their highest preseason rank in ten years.
"It's awesome just knowing that we're going to start the season out, really proving what we are," said Penguins offensive lineman Shane Keenan. "Right now we have a lot of returning starters, so it's a lot of hearsay about how good we're going to be. But we're fired up, like really, really excited. Can't wait. This is the most prepared and comfortable I've felt going into a week one --week zero game ever."
"I think we're really excited to get the season started, especially being a week zero game and just honestly getting the attention of the fans to come out and support us," added Cam Smith, Penguins senior defensive back. "I know there's a lot of buzz around our team right now, and I think honestly, we're just excited to get as many people there as we can and show all the hard work that we put in throughout the offseason and this training camp."
"It's always great when you walk through that tailgate lot and game day and it's packed. It's always great when that crowd's behind you. Our guys kind of feed from it," said YSU head coach Doug Phillips. "I was at that concert this summer, and to see the stadium packed for a concert, I mean, that's what you strive for. And it's got to be us. It's got to be us being successful in the field, successful in the community, and building excitement that people fear of missing out.
Youngstown State and Mercyhurst will kick off Thursday at 6 p.m. at Stambaugh Stadium.
